headlines.description: — Joshua Dobbs ran for a 50-yard touchdown and the Detroit Lions held on for a 17-13 preseason win against the Washington Commanders on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dobbs overcomes two turnovers with long TD run as Lions beat Commanders, 17-13

headlines.description: — As thunder rumbled around Huntington Bank Field following Saturday's game, the Browns' confusing quarterback competition grew stormier.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shedeur Sanders throws TD pass in final chance to win starting QB job but Bills batter Browns 31-7

headlines.description: — Atlanta Falcons quarterbacks Cooper Rush and Jack Strand took advantage of perhaps their last opportunity to shine this season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons' Penix cleared to practice as Rush and Strand pick apart Colts in 34-6 preseason win

headlines.description: — J.J. McCarthy had an erratic start for the Minnesota Vikings, completing 5 of 10 passes for 81 yards in a 13-3 exhibition loss to Baltimore on Saturday, while undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano threw...
headlines.shortLinkText: J.J. McCarthy's misfires at QB stand out for the Vikings in a 13-3 preseason loss to the Ravens

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — Stetson Bennett cleared up the Los Angeles Rams' backup quarterback situation a bit with another solid outing Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stetson Bennett looks sharp, Saints' backup QBs don't separate in Rams' 34-0 preseason win

events.name: New York Giants at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: — The New York Giants appeared to be the better team during their joint practice with the Miami Dolphins this week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jameis Winston runs for a touchdown in the Giants' 26-3 preseason win over the Dolphins

headlines.description: — With Joe Burrow, Joe Flacco and the rest of Cincinnati's starters and key backups watching in street clothes, 40-year-old journeyman Josh Johnson led the Bengals to a 27-9 preseason victory over the Chicago Bears on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: 40-year-old journeyman QB Josh Johnson leads Bengals to 27-9 preseason victory over Bears

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New England Patriots

headlines.description: — The Patriots are set at quarterback with Drake Maye. So are the Eagles with Jalen Hurts. But the players vying to back them up made strong statements in Saturday's preseason game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tommy DeVito throws TD pass, Ja’Quinden Jackson taken off in ambulance as Patriots beat Eagles 24-21

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — A stellar night for Harrison Butker soured in a hurry.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs' Butker kicks 69-yard field goal, but has late misses as Daniels rallies Bucs to 16-15 win

headlines.description: — Joe Milton had another good day in his quest to become the Dallas Cowboys' backup quarterback. Coach Brian Schottenheimer says there's still work to be done.
headlines.shortLinkText: Milton throws 2 TDs in 1st half, makes case for Cowboys' backup job in 34-13 win over Cardinals
